page_title: LYO 2-1 STR | Lyon v Strasbourg 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Yellow card! It's like Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Eric Wattellier agrees and books him.
90+7' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+5' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Alaa Bellaarouch no chance!
90+5' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+4' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Lyon!
90+4' Referee Eric Wattellier makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lyon. Let’s see what happens!
90+3' Malick Fofana (Lyon) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Nicolas Tagliafico comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon).
86' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
85' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
83' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) squanders a big chance! The ball rebounded out to him and he misdirects his shot well wide of the left post.
83' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
83' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Rabby Nzingoula and he is replaced by Patrick Ouotro (Strasbourg).
81' NO PENALTY! Referee Eric Wattellier has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Lyon players are incensed.
81' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Lyon using VAR. Let's see what happens.
80' Patrick Vieira appears to have said too much and referee Eric Wattellier comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.

80' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Eric Wattellier blows for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Lyon after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
77' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) fails to convert the penalty kick! His effort hits the left post.
77' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
76' Orel Mangala (Lyon) was too forceful with his tackle and Eric Wattellier interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A penalty is given to Strasbourg!
74' Strasbourg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

74' A pass travels right across the box to Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Anthony Lopes denies him with a decent save. The referee signals a corner kick to Strasbourg.
70' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
69' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Habib Diarra will be replaced by Aboubacar Ali Abdallah (Strasbourg).
69' Substitution. Rayan Cherki will be replaced by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon).
69' Here comes a substitution. Malick Fofana (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Said Benrahma.
68' Pierre Sage prepares a substitution. Corentin Tolisso is replaced by Orel Mangala (Lyon).
67' That's the end of the game for Thomas Delaine, who is replaced by Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg).
63' 1 - 1 Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
62' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
61' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
59' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
57' Chance! Rayan Cherki (Lyon) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
56' Referee Eric Wattellier sees the trip by Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
54' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

53' Alaa Bellaarouch was forced into action to thwart Corentin Tolisso (Lyon). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
51' The linesman signals that Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
48' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
48' Lyon quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
47' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Eric Wattellier has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' None of the Strasbourg players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Lyon work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lyon.
44' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Eric Wattellier no option but to blow his whistle.
43' Rabby Nzingoula (Strasbourg) is able to continue to play.
41' Rabby Nzingoula (Strasbourg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Said Benrahma tees up Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) inside the box and he curls the ball into the right side of the net and past Alaa Bellaarouch.
37' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
37' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
36' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lyon.
36' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

35' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Said Benrahma (Lyon) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
32' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Anthony Lopes as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
31' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Anthony Lopes comes off the line to clear the ball away.
30' 59:41 – the latest ball possession ratio.
27' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will have a throw-in.
26' The rebound finds Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
26' Great save! Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Alaa Bellaarouch.
24' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
22' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Anthony Lopes is equal to it and makes an easy save.
18' A precise cross aimed towards the penalty spot was met by Jake O'Brien (Lyon). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the right post.
18' Said Benrahma (Lyon) takes the corner with a short pass.

17' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Lyon can continue in their attacking effort.
15' Clinton Mata (Lyon) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alaa Bellaarouch intercepts the ball.
14' Rabby Nzingoula (Strasbourg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
12' Rabby Nzingoula (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
8' Said Benrahma (Lyon) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
7' Said Benrahma (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but Alaa Bellaarouch comes off his line to gather the ball.
6' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
6' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
5' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) has a goal ruled out for offside!
2' Said Benrahma (Lyon) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
1' Eric Wattellier blows for a foul after Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Strasbourg will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Eric Wattellier.
